The incident remains unresolved with high risk of lateral movement and data exfiltration.

        author = "SOC Analyst Team"

        $c = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // padding pattern
    condition:
        all of them
}

}
